## 1.3.38 (HexGhoul): real speech bubbles: white, rounded, outlined, with a tail; thought clouds for actions; a "z Z z" cloud over sleepers (testing)
HexKagune 1.3.38 for Forge 1.20.1. Install on client and server (**protocol 67**, unchanged). Testing build: compiled, tests pass, shapes checked in an offline render, **not tried in game**.

- **Real speech bubbles.** What your spouse, your children and wild ghouls say now shows in an actual comic speech bubble over their head: white, rounded corners, a dark outline, a tail pointing down to whoever's talking, black text. No more name-tag strips.
- **Thought clouds.** Actions and thoughts (the lines in asterisks, like "\*stirs, mumbling, and snuggles in\*") show in a thought cloud: puffy edges all round, a softer grey outline, two little puffs trailing down to the head, dark grey italic text.
- **Sleepers snore.** A spouse or child asleep in bed with nothing to say shows a small "z Z z" cloud now and then, growing "z", "z Z", "z Z z".
- Bubbles pop in (a quick grow and settle), always face you, stay full white at night, and only show when you can see the speaker (as before). Each one is still only up as long as it takes to read.

Untested in game: compiled, unit tested and checked in an offline render only. Try: talk to your spouse or child, right click one asleep at night, meet a wild ghoul.
